class.name: SentryNativeOptions
class.description: Contains configuration options for the sentry-native SDK, which is used on Linux and Windows. Access this configuration through [member SentryOptions.native]. Configure these options in Project Settings under [b]Sentry > Native[/b], or override them in the initialization callback passed to [method SentrySDK.init]. Crashpad is the default crash backend. To use the native crash backend in an exported game, select [b]Native[/b] under [b]Sentry > Crash Backend[/b] in the Linux or Windows export preset.

members.member: Controls how crash data is collected and sent to Sentry: a minidump for server-side stackwalking, an event with client-side stacktraces, or an event with client-side stacktraces and a minidump attachment. Defaults to [constant CRASH_REPORTING_MODE_NATIVE_WITH_MINIDUMP]. [b]Note:[/b] Applies only to the native crash backend on Linux and Windows; other crash backends ignore this option.

Controls whether the crashed application waits for upload and daemon shutdown. Defaults to [constant CRASH_UPLOAD_MODE_SYNC]. Asynchronous upload allows the application to terminate after crash data is captured while the daemon continues uploading. Capture itself still blocks. [b]Note:[/b] Applies only to the native crash backend on Linux and Windows; other crash backends ignore this option.

Controls how much memory is captured in crash minidumps. Defaults to [constant MINIDUMP_MODE_SMART]. Applies only when [member crash_reporting_mode] includes a minidump. Larger captures take longer to generate and upload. [b]Note:[/b] Applies only to the native crash backend on Linux and Windows; other crash backends ignore this option.

Controls which threads receive client-side stacktraces. Defaults to [constant THREAD_STACKWALK_MODE_ALL]. Applies only when [member crash_reporting_mode] enables native stackwalking. In crashed-thread-only mode, other threads are still reported with their IDs and names, without stacktraces. Walking all threads provides more context but can delay crash collection in applications with many threads. [b]Note:[/b] Applies only to the native crash backend on Linux and Windows; other crash backends ignore this option.

constants.constant: Send a minidump for server-side stackwalking and symbolication.
Send an event with client-side stacktraces, without a minidump.
Send an event with client-side stacktraces and a minidump attachment.
Capture stack memory and heap memory around the crash site.
Walk only the crashed thread. Other threads retain their IDs and names.
Keep the application blocked until the crash daemon finishes upload and shutdown.
Allow the application to terminate after crash data is captured while the daemon continues upload and shutdown work.
